status: proposed planning baseline; not approved or build-ready
vision: Turn content scattered across permitted sources into trustworthy, evidence-backed information that each connected system can use.
principles: Register sources deliberately; browsing stays within an explicit scope and budget.
Capture once and preserve originals; decisions and derived fields remain versioned.
Use a small common envelope plus content-type and system-specific schemas.
A content item can qualify for zero, one or several systems independently.
Unknown, unavailable and rejected are different states; no silent fabrication.
Every extracted fact and decision must be inspectable against its evidence.
Final qualification and destination validation precede storage and delivery.
Human corrections are audited and rechecked; source evidence is not overwritten.

strategy.title: Start with one operational workflow
strategy.choice: Proposed pilot: an analyst turns permitted funding or procurement notices into qualified opportunity records. This is an example wedge, not a user-approved market choice.
strategy.tradeoff: Broad platform positioning before proving repeatable value delays learning.

strategy.title: Prove the complete loop first
strategy.choice: R1 supports a small approved HTML/PDF source set, two independent system configurations and one validated delivery contract. Use a sandbox receiver until a real destination is authorised.
strategy.tradeoff: General connectors and every media type are deferred, while the data model remains extensible.

strategy.title: Evidence before automation volume
strategy.choice: Preserve originals, coverage, field evidence, rule reasons and review outcomes. Autonomous delivery only follows approved system policy.
strategy.tradeoff: A lower throughput with inspectable decisions is preferable to unmeasured automated output.

strategy.title: Separate relevance from qualification
strategy.choice: First decide relevance per system; then extract that system’s fields and apply business rules. Enrich when allowed and requalify.
strategy.tradeoff: Avoid one global classifier determining eligibility for every consumer.

strategy.title: Reuse infrastructure, own the workflow
strategy.choice: Evaluate existing capture, parsing, OCR and transcription components. Build the policy, evidence, schema, review and routing layer around measured requirements.
strategy.tradeoff: No vendor, model, runtime or subscription is selected by this plan.

strategy.title: Expand on observed evidence
strategy.choice: Advance from controlled pilot to authenticated/multimodal breadth and then scale only after release exit and learning reviews.
strategy.tradeoff: Dates and staffing commitments wait for estimation and explicit capacity.

metrics.name: Analyst time per accepted record
metrics.definition: Median active analyst minutes from item opening to a correct qualified record; compare paired records with the manual baseline.
metrics.target: Proposed: at least 50% reduction on 30 or more paired items.
metrics.denominator: All paired items attempted; failures retained separately rather than dropped.
metrics.window: First 4 pilot weeks; extend if fewer than 30 pairs.
metrics.uncertainty: Report paired distribution and bootstrap interval; avoid causal claims from an uncontrolled pilot.

metrics.name: Critical-field correctness
metrics.definition: Correct critical-field values / adjudicated critical-field opportunities; required missing values count as incorrect.
metrics.target: Proposed: >=95% overall; each critical field and source family reported separately.
metrics.denominator: Proposed frozen acceptance set: >=200 items and >=30 per material slice; oversample costly failure cases separately.
metrics.uncertainty: Report numerator, denominator and 95% Wilson intervals; sample adequacy and release thresholds require approval.

metrics.name: System relevance precision and recall
metrics.definition: Precision = true relevant routes / all routes; recall = true relevant routes / all adjudicated relevant items, computed independently per system.
metrics.target: Proposed: precision >=95%, recall >=90%; report abstention and review rates.
metrics.denominator: Frozen positive and negative set per system, including sampled rejects and multi-system overlaps.
metrics.window: Before publication and weekly during pilot.
metrics.uncertainty: Report per-system/slice counts and intervals. Empty or inadequate slices cannot pass.

metrics.name: Evidence coverage
metrics.definition: Delivered non-null extracted field values with valid evidence pointers / all delivered non-null extracted field values. Derived values must identify inputs and transformation.
metrics.target: Proposed hard invariant: 100%; no fabricated citation accepted.
metrics.denominator: Every delivered record in the qualified candidate test and pilot audit.
metrics.uncertainty: A pointer’s existence is not proof of semantic support; M02 and human audit assess support.

metrics.name: Recovery and destination safety
metrics.definition: Replay, crash, timeout, cancellation, stale update and permission-revocation scenarios preserve controlled effects.
metrics.target: Proposed: zero unauthorised disclosures and zero duplicate destination effects in the required scenario suite.
metrics.denominator: All named scenarios for each supported connector and destination.
metrics.window: Before pilot and affected connector changes.
metrics.uncertainty: Zero observed failures is a test result, not proof that failures are impossible.

metrics.name: Cost and review burden
metrics.definition: Total capture, storage, model and human-review cost / accepted records; review queue arrival and completion rates.
metrics.target: Pending approved cost ceiling and reviewer capacity. Report capture-to-record p50/p95 latency.
metrics.denominator: Include rejected items, retries and failed runs in total cost.
metrics.uncertainty: No cost, latency or scalability claim until workload and budget are approved.

releases.title: Validate the first workflow
releases.outcome: Select a permitted pilot and establish its manual baseline, data rights, field contract and evaluation plan.
releases.scope: Four discovery stories; no live source collection or external delivery is authorised by this document.
releases.entry: User has authorised product planning; only synthetic or already permitted local examples may be used.
releases.exit: Named pilot users, source/destination permission evidence, critical fields, baseline protocol and approved evaluation targets are recorded.
releases.learn: Reject or narrow the pilot if source permissions, reliable evidence extraction or a useful workflow cannot be established.

releases.title: Prove one complete, trustworthy loop
releases.outcome: An operator collects supported HTML/PDF content, routes it independently to two configured consumers, reviews uncertain fields and delivers a validated record through one approved destination contract.
releases.scope: Small permitted source allowlist; bounded public and one approved authenticated access path; common/type/system fields; relevance; qualification; bounded linked-document enrichment; review; storage; safe delivery and core governance.
releases.entry: R0 exit, actual team Ready checklist, required privacy/data-use decisions, owners, model/data contracts and an authorised test environment.
releases.exit: Included story acceptance and mandatory safety checks pass; frozen AI thresholds are met; unknown delivery reconciliation and rollback are exercised; pilot users complete the end-to-end journey.
releases.learn: Review after 4 weeks or the minimum usable sample, whichever is later. Continue only if user value and approved quality/cost gates hold; otherwise narrow sources or revise extraction.

releases.title: Extend media and recurring workflows
releases.outcome: Operators process supported images, scanned documents and audiovisual content with region/time evidence, and manage recurring source updates.
releases.scope: OCR/visual extraction, video/audio transcription and timestamped evidence, bulk source import, scheduling, richer nested fields, time-sensitive rechecks, additional explicitly qualified access adapters.
releases.entry: R1 outcome review supports expansion; media rights, provider limits, language slices and modality evaluation contracts are approved.
releases.exit: Each added modality/access adapter meets its own coverage, critical-field, safety and recovery gates; partial and unavailable media are explicit.
releases.learn: Compare incremental value, human correction and cost by modality; disable or narrow modalities that fail their approved gates.

releases.title: Operate repeatably across more systems
releases.outcome: Expand qualified connectors and throughput within measured tenant isolation, latency, reliability and cost limits.
releases.scope: Connector fleet operations and capacity work only after demand and workload are established; additional roadmap items require new bounded stories.
releases.entry: R2 learning, real demand, capacity estimates, operational ownership and approved service/cost targets.
releases.exit: Named workload/load/recovery tests meet approved targets; on-call response and tenant isolation are exercised.
releases.learn: Review unit economics and support load before each further rollout; retire low-value connectors.
